headline.text: L1 S3 tunnel belt fraying on *both sides* — QA approved run-to-downtime after cutting loose material, foreign-material risk present until repair.

summary: One active belt-fraying event on L1 S3 with foreign-material risk approved to run until scheduled repair. L3 ML4 belt ripped and was fixed same-shift. Sanitation gaps flagged at L1 wash areas and L3 Truffle Cavanna 2.

food_safety.title: Tunnel 1 belt fraying on both sides
food_safety.summary: Belt tracked back and forth, rubbed on bolt, frayed on both edges — frayed pieces cut off, QA approved continued run with plan to burn edges tonight during downtime.
food_safety.status: Open — approved to run until downtime, edges to be burned tonight.

food_safety.title: ML1 cleaning rollers received without covers
food_safety.summary: Belts C5 and C6 cleaning rollers received with excess product and covers missing — food-contact equipment left exposed.
food_safety.status: Resolved — rollers cleaned, covers reinstalled by 09:20.

food_safety.title: ML4 demolding belt ripping (North side)
food_safety.summary: Belt after demolding ripped on north side — maintenance notified, issue resolved same shift at 08:17.

quality.title: S3 jar labelers — persistent wrinkles on labels
quality.summary: Both A and B side labelers struggling with wrinkled labels — suspected jar material too soft and bends easily during application, two lots tested with same result.
quality.status: Open — running WIP (unlabeled jars to rework), Leon called to troubleshoot, labeler B functional by 11:31.

sanitation.title: Wash area 1 and 2 — dirty buckets and pipe on floor
sanitation.summary: Yellow bucket with cream or butter residue, dirty water bucket, and pipe left on floor in both wash areas — flagged for cleanup.
sanitation.status: Open — cleanup requested from Justin Garner.

sanitation.title: Truffle Cavanna 2 received dirty at shift start
sanitation.summary: Matrix 1 clean, but Cavanna 2 scrapers, fingers, and belts not cleaned during 3rd shift CILT — led to production pause for cleaning.
sanitation.status: Resolved — cleaned during pause, feedback provided to 3rd shift team.

opportunities.text: Consider adding tunnel belt edge-condition inspection to S3 startup checklist — today's fraying on both sides echoes tracking issues and could have been caught earlier.
Review CILT checklist completeness verification at Truffle line — Cavanna 2 scrapers, fingers, and belts were missed by 3rd shift, requiring re-clean at 1st shift startup.
Add cleaning-roller cover installation to ML1 handoff checklist — rollers on C5 and C6 were received without covers and with product buildup.
